item.title: PyTorch Conference North America 2026: Accelerating Open Intelligence Together
item.description:
发表方：PyTorch Blog　发布：2026-10-22　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 PyTorch Conference North America 2026 亮点汇总：编译/推理栈多硬件后端密集进展。

要点 TorchTPU：Google/Meta 合作的 TPU 原生 PyTorch 后端，支持 eager+torch.compile，验证覆盖 TorchTitan/vLLM/SGLang/Ray；TorchNeuron：AWS Trainium（Trn2/Trn3）原生后端，Apache 2.0 公开测试；IBM 的 SpyreCode MLIR 数据流后端及 AMD MI350 可选后端；TitanRL 为 TorchTitan 引入强化学习；ExecuTorch Cortex-M 后端支持 Arm CMSIS-NN 与 Scalar/DSP/MVE 全档位；Helion 集成 NVIDIA CompileIQ 内核自动调优。

关键数字 3,500+ 参会者，10 月 20-21 日圣何塞举办；TorchNeuron 公开测试 10 月 20 日发布；9 家新成员加入 PyTorch 基金会（含 Nebius、Nscale、Shopify）；2027 大会定于 10 月 6-7 日。

为什么值得看 PyTorch 生态"任意芯片、任意云"愿景的落地全景，多硬件编译栈进展集中更新。

item.title: Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

A benchmark is not merely a collection of test questions; it naturally induces an empirical measure over difficulty.

A benchmark is not merely a collection of test questions; it naturally induces an empirical measure over difficulty. In this work, we develop this measure-based view of benchmark evaluation. This perspective allows us to identify and formalize two central failure modes: measure mismatch, where the benchmark difficulty distribution differs from the intended difficulty distribution, and coverage gaps, where uncovered regions along the difficulty axis prevent benchmarks from detecting meaningful localized training progress. We propose two diagnostic metrics that capture these two failure modes and provide rigorous theoretical guarantees. Empirically, we analyze 25 popular benchmarks spanning 7 domains using carefully estimated item difficulties. Our results show that many benchmarks implicitly overweight certain difficulty regions, so their leaderboard conclusions should be interpreted with caution; others leave substantial portions of the difficulty axis uncovered, limiting their ability to monitor the model improvement process. Finally, we turn diagnosis into action by introducing BenchFill, a simple difficulty-targeted item rewriting algorithm that effectively reduces local coverag…

item.title: YingLan: A Multimodal Ocean Foundation Model for Unified Representation Learning from Heterogeneous Observations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Multimodal ocean modeling remains challenging due to substantial heterogeneity in data structures, physical semantics, and spatiotemporal characteristics across satellite imagery, gridded oceanographic fields, and buoy observations.

Multimodal ocean modeling remains challenging due to substantial heterogeneity in data structures, physical semantics, and spatiotemporal characteristics across satellite imagery, gridded oceanographic fields, and buoy observations. Existing approaches largely focus on task-specific ocean modeling, while learning transferable representations from heterogeneous observations remains an open problem. To address this challenge, we propose YingLan, a multimodal ocean foundation model that integrates physics-attribute-conditioned dynamic encoding, Spatiotemporal Increment Coupling (STIC), and ocean-state evolution-aware pretraining. Specifically, the dynamic encoding mechanism generates adaptive input projections conditioned on physical semantics and observation characteristics, enabling flexible representation of heterogeneous ocean variables. STIC models multiscale spatiotemporal dependencies through cross-scale interactions of latent temporal increments. The pretraining strategy further combines masked observation reconstruction with temporal evolution objectives to facilitate the learning of coherent ocean-state representations across different prediction horizons. item.title: WRDO: Weighted Refusal Direction Optimization in Aligned Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Aligned large language models are trained to comply with benign requests while refusing harmful ones.

Aligned large language models are trained to comply with benign requests while refusing harmful ones. However, recent work shows that this refusal behavior is fragile and can often be disrupted by simple activation- or weight-space interventions. In particular, refusal has been shown to be largely mediated by a single residual-stream direction, typically computed as a difference-of-means vector between harmful and harmless prompts. However, this standard construction aggregates heterogeneous harmful prompts into one uniform average, potentially conflating distinct refusal-related phenomena. In this work, we study whether refusal interventions can be strengthened by learning how to combine prompt-specific refusal directions. We propose Weighted Refusal Direction Optimization (WRDO), a procedure that constructs a composite refusal direction from a bank of per-prompt directions using learned aggregation weights. This approach allows different harmful prompts to contribute unequally to the final intervention direction. We evaluate WRDO against prior single-direction methods on three open-weight language models using three guard judges and HarmBench as an external evaluator. We further …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Value-Rectified Distillation for Flow-based Offline Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

We aim to address the problem of Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Mode Averaging, a critical problem that emerges when distilling Flow Matching (FM) based behavior policies in offline Reinforcement Learning

We aim to address the problem of Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Mode Averaging, a critical problem that emerges when distilling Flow Matching (FM) based behavior policies in offline Reinforcement Learning (RL): When learning over multi-modal datasets, standard distillation inadvertently forces the policy to interpolate across different behavioral modes, causing the generated actions to collapse into invalid, OOD regions. To resolve this, we propose Value-Rectified Distillation (VRD), a novel framework that reformulates offline policy distillation as a value-guided generative trajectory alignment problem. By employing a dynamic coupling mechanism, VRD actively rectifies flow dynamics to explicitly decouple distinct behavioral modes, cleanly isolating high-value actions. Specifically, we instantiate VRD through two complementary algorithms: VRD-Q, which utilizes value-quantile behavior distillation to statistically filter out low-value behaviors, and VRD-R, which reorganizes the latent space to geometrically isolate high-value generative trajectories from the FM-based behavior policy. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that VRD improves existing generative baselines across divers…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: UlaCache: Unified Logical Addressing for Sparse LLM Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 长上下文使 LLM 推理中 KV cache 内存成本大增；稀疏注意力虽降低计算与内存流量，但保留的 KV cache 必须在后续解码步骤持续可用，管理复杂。

方法 UlaCache 围绕统一逻辑地址空间构建：跨越 GPU KV 池与可选 CPU 内存，稳定逻辑引用让分配与物理放置解耦；统一分配与稀疏访问接口支持数据并行（DP）与张量并行（TP）attention；启用 CPU 存储时用 Parallel Bucketed LRU（PB-LRU）并行管理共享 GPU 池。

关键数字 匹配 CPU/GPU 内存预算+推测解码下，H200 峰值解码吞吐较最先进基线 DP 1.16x/TP 1.70x，B300 上 DP 1.73x/TP 2.51x。

为什么值得看 稀疏注意力 serving 的 KV 管理基础设施，逻辑寻址思路简洁，DP/TP 双支持覆盖主流部署。

item.title: The End of Consensus Research?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Consensus is a fundamental problem in distributed computing and at the core of state machine replication (SMR).

Consensus is a fundamental problem in distributed computing and at the core of state machine replication (SMR). Despite decades of active human research, discovering practical low-latency solutions to the problem is still open, as it requires combining protocol knowledge, correctness reasoning, implementation, and experimental evaluation. We report on how AI helped us discover A-greement, a new consensus protocol for geo-replicated state machines that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art solutions. Averaged across six deployments with 5 or 9 replicas, A-greement reduces the mean latency of a geo-distributed key-value store over the fastest baseline by 12.2% and 33.3% on write-heavy and read-heavy workloads, respectively, and matches the fastest baseline on read-only workloads. A-greement combines lease-authorized local reads, direct client learning for leader-ordered writes, and a fast fixed-quorum per-key write path, selected according to network topology and workload. At the heart of our discovery lies AI-greement, an agent harness for the "autonomous" discovery, implementation, experimentation, and verification of candidate protocols. AI-greement integrates (1) a concept-o…

item.title: Structure-Aware Message Passing on Petri Nets through Directed Walks and Incidence Diffusion
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

A common application of the process mining discipline is to connect observed event data with Petri nets, which are bipartite, directed graphical process models with rich formal underpinnings.

A common application of the process mining discipline is to connect observed event data with Petri nets, which are bipartite, directed graphical process models with rich formal underpinnings. Recent work learns vector representations of Petri nets to retrieve process models and relate them to event logs, but leaves implicit two key aspects hidden within the net's structure: directed cycles (process loops) and invariants recorded by the net's incidence matrix. We expose both of these to message-passing graph neural networks, through a positional encoding built from return probabilities of directed place-transition walks (PNRWPE), and through same-type messages gated by diffusion kernels of the incidence matrix (DA-PNGNN). Our constructions raise macro balanced accuracy in predicting the generation factors of the 96 Process Discovery Contest 2023 models from 0.751 to 0.796 with PNRWPE, which nearly doubles accuracy on process loops, and to 0.830 with DA-PNGNN, which, without retuning, also improves net-to-tree retrieval top-1 accuracy on the self-supervised ProcRosetta benchmark by 4.1 to 5.9 points.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

阅读原文 ↗

item.title: Stochastic Pruning of the DPO Computation Graph: 1.4x Faster Training and Lower Peak Memory
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Direct preference optimization (DPO) incurs training costs in output scoring, sequence execution, and backpropagation, so reducing supervision alone does not necessarily save computation.

Direct preference optimization (DPO) incurs training costs in output scoring, sequence execution, and backpropagation, so reducing supervision alone does not necessarily save computation. We introduce a unified framework for stochastic pruning of the DPO computation graph that independently samples response positions for scoring, response prefixes for execution, and preference branches for backpropagation. By making these selections before the corresponding operations, the framework omits computation at each stage of a training step. Our analysis characterizes the objective changes induced by position and sequence pruning and uses inverse-probability weighting to obtain a conditionally unbiased single-branch gradient estimator for the sampled objective. Controlled measurements show that position and sequence pruning primarily reduce peak memory, with most output-memory savings attributable to an implementation that retains full response supervision. Branch pruning yields a $1.426\times$ step-time speedup over a concatenated DPO baseline and reduces training time by about 30\% relative to stock DPO across two model families, with slightly lower mean accuracy and benchmark-dependent …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Shortcut-Resistant CAM Distillation for Long-Tailed Recognition
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Real-world datasets often follow a long-tailed distribution, making generalization to tail classes difficult.

Real-world datasets often follow a long-tailed distribution, making generalization to tail classes difficult. We revisit this problem through the lens of shortcut learning, where models prefer the easiest predictive cues (e.g., background or textures) over object-centric semantics, especially under scarce and biased supervision. We find that this tendency is amplified for tail classes: limited examples often share similar contexts, making non-semantic signals highly correlated and thus tempting shortcuts, whereas head classes with diverse appearances and environments encourage more stable object-focused representations. Motivated by this observation, we propose Shortcut-Resistant CAM Distillation (SRCD), a plug-and-play framework that transfers object-focused explanations from head to tail classes. SRCD operates in the Class Activation Map (CAM) space, where a CAM provides a class-specific spatial evidence map for a prediction. SRCD aggregates CAMs from a small set of head-class candidates into a shortcut-resistant teacher using an energy-model weighting based on coherence and concentration, and distills it to the tail-class CAM. We provide a theoretical analysis that quantifies sh…

item.title: Semantic-Aware Update Admission and Adaptive Byzantine Redundancy for Secure Computation Offloading in COIN-Enabled Metaverse Systems
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Computing in the network (COIN) supports latency-sensitive Metaverse services, but blockchain commitment of persistent shared-state updates competes with application execution for limited resources.

Computing in the network (COIN) supports latency-sensitive Metaverse services, but blockchain commitment of persistent shared-state updates competes with application execution for limited resources. We consider the joint problem of deciding which updates to commit, how much Byzantine redundancy to provision, and where to execute Metaverse application tasks. We formulate this problem under resource, latency, and practical Byzantine fault tolerance (PBFT) constraints, accounting for update persistence and semantic significance. We develop a hierarchical redundancy-aware PBFT (R-PBFT) approach that decomposes the decision process into slot-wise computation offloading and sequential update-admission and redundancy control. We formulate the former as an identical-interest game and address the latter using a feasibility-filtered double deep Q-network (DDQN). Analytical downlink allocation accounts for the energy and delivery-feasibility effects of consensus latency. For fixed slot state and redundancy, we establish the game's exact-potential property and finite termination of strict sequential improvements. Feasible-action filtering enforces configured Byzantine redundancy and blockchain…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: SPARE: Sparsity Allocation via Routing Entropy for Efficient MoEs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 MoE 专家剪枝大多只关注剪哪些专家且对每层均等修剪，忽略了各层路由分散程度的差异，剪枝内存收益有提升空间。

方法 SPARE 免训练、选择器无关：用校准数据上 token 归一化 Top-K 门控权重的路由熵决定每层移除多少专家——路由越分散说明删掉一个活跃专家损失越小，剪得越激进；随机剪枝下的扰动界形式化该直觉，并用固定选择器的受控干预验证。

关键数字 同一选择器与预算下，50% 专家剪枝时 Qwen3-30B-A3B 八任务平均从 57.2% 提升到 63.8%，DeepSeek-R1 数学/代码/科学平均从 80.1 提升到 82.8。

为什么值得看 免训练、即插即用的逐层稀疏分配，对 MoE 部署内存优化有直接实用价值。

item.title: Resuming Vision-Language Inference across Onboard Interruptions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 低轨卫星上执行 VLM 推理时，请求可能跨多个执行窗口：功耗/热约束、故障重启、竞争载荷都会中断推理，断电即丢弃激活与 KV cache，未保护请求重启后被迫重复劳动。

方法 OrbitWeaver 协调检查点与恢复：阶段感知检查点按视觉编码、语言 prefill、解码的状态生命周期与计算特征选择恢复边界，平衡存储流量与重算；依赖感知动态恢复跨层与 token 块维度调度；检查点与权重读取和重算重叠以降低重启延迟。

关键数字 恢复规划器在 100ms 内计算最优执行顺序；卫星载荷硬件+在轨遥测轨迹实验端到端加速最高 4.07x、SSD 写入量降 3.56x；两颗低轨卫星 72 小时部署验证跨多次总线强制关机的恢复。

为什么值得看 太空边缘 AI 的务实工程，检查点/恢复设计对各类受限设备的长期运行都有借鉴。

item.title: Reorienting the Vector Axis: Restructuring FlashAttention for Long-Vector Processors
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 FlashAttention 及其后续工作几乎都面向 GPU；长向量处理器（单向量寄存器可容 512 个单精度数）上向量化哪条循环是一阶决策，GPU 内核移植后性能大幅损失。

方法 将 PyTorch CPU FlashAttention 移植到 2KB 向量寄存器的 RISC-V CPU 后提出两项技术：转置 score tile 与运行输出使 query 沿连续轴（单参数即可匹配机器向量长，且两类 reduction 消失）；把 softmax 多项式系数移入标量寄存器消除溢出。

关键数字 原移植仅达峰值浮点吞吐的 16.2%；两项技术联合使整核周期减少 1.84-2.08x（head=64），浮点利用率升至 29.7%，softmax 向量内存指令减少 78.7%；同设计 FPGA 评分更高，达 2.71x。

为什么值得看 非 GPU 长向量架构的 attention 优化稀缺，对 RISC-V/边缘向量处理器有直接参考。

item.title: Reliability-Aware Probabilistic Fusion for Multimodal Learning with Incomplete Evidence
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Multimodal inputs may be missing or degraded, raising distinct questions of evidence availability and trust.

Multimodal inputs may be missing or degraded, raising distinct questions of evidence availability and trust. We introduce a reliability-aware Gaussian Product-of-Experts (PoE) in which an input-dependent reliability weight tempers each modality's latent precision, while missing experts are omitted. We characterize how reliability and availability affect posterior information and expert influence. Across two clinical multimodal tasks, the full framework remains competitive with complete inputs and achieves its clearest mean-AUROC advantage under modality absence, particularly on HAIM-MIMIC-MM. Ablations show a substantial gain from missing-aware training and an additional HAIM improvement from reliability weighting under matched PoE, missing-aware, and consistency training. Unseen test-time corruptions are used diagnostically and reveal modality-dependent reliability-weight and latent-uncertainty responses, including failure under severe degradation. Thus, reliability weighting provides an explicit evidence-control mechanism, while learning dependable quality signals remains an open challenge.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Reader--Writer Coupling in Transformer MLPs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

A transformer MLP gives each hidden channel two roles: a reader that decides when the channel responds, and a writer that decides what it adds back to the residual stream.

A transformer MLP gives each hidden channel two roles: a reader that decides when the channel responds, and a writer that decides what it adds back to the residual stream. Read as a key--value memory, the layer can be measured one factor set at a time: the pairing of readers to writers is carried only by their shared index, invisible to any quantity computed from one factor set alone. Yet training couples the two factors through their joint update, so we ask what reading them together shows. The block supplies the joint instrument: the MLP writes back into the very stream it reads, so the exact Jacobian of its update is square, and its agreement with its own transpose resolves into reader--writer terms whose inner products give each channel, read as a couple, a signed pairing coordinate. Ranked by this coordinate, each block we measure has a small core of strongly coupled channels; where initialization gives either sign equally, the core is nearly all opposed: each writer points against the direction its reader responds to. This opposed core recurs from the smallest models trained from scratch to released checkpoints; its sign is in place within a few percent of training and holds …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: RISK-KV: Quality-Aware Selective KV Cache Reconstruction for Distributed LLM Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 分布式 LLM 推理的请求迁移与中断恢复依赖历史 KV cache：完整保留/传输状态开销巨大，重放历史 token 又需额外计算。

方法 RISK-KV 质量感知的选择性 KV 重建：用目标层两侧的精确 KV 状态配合跨层岭回归预测缺失层的 attention-projection 输入，再折叠原始 KV 投影矩阵降低预测器存储；以重建导致的 NLL 变化度量风险，低开销拓扑搜索+质量门控选择要重建的层组。

关键数字 三个 LM 上代表性恢复配置省略 18.2%-33.3% 历史 KV，困惑度变化低于 0.5%；512-token 历史的本机恢复实验中比完整 token 重放快 1.51-3.31 倍。

为什么值得看 用预测重建替代全量缓存/重放，为分布式 serving 容错与迁移提供低开销新路径。

item.title: Private Online Prediction from Experts with Small Losses
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

We consider online prediction from experts, a fundamental problem in machine learning, under differential privacy constraints.

We consider online prediction from experts, a fundamental problem in machine learning, under differential privacy constraints. Existing private algorithms achieve near-optimal regret $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$, where $T$ is the time horizon. However, this bound becomes suboptimal when $L^\star$, the cumulative loss of the best expert, is significantly less than $T$. In this work, we present the first differentially private algorithm with regret $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{L^\star})$, offering a substantial improvement in the low-loss regime. Our regret bound matches the non-private lower bound up to poly-logarithmic factors for constant privacy parameters, demonstrating that privacy incurs only a small cost in this setting. Our result assumes that the input sequence is oblivious, i.e., it is fixed in advance and independent of the algorithm's outputs. We also prove that an $\tildeΩ(\sqrt{T})$ regret is inevitable for adaptively generated inputs, even when $L^\star = 0$.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Privacy in Context Is Being Overlooked in the Age of General-Purpose LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

As large language models (LLMs) continue to grow in scope and capability, privacy concerns are on the rise.

As large language models (LLMs) continue to grow in scope and capability, privacy concerns are on the rise. Since users increasingly interact with a single general-purpose system across many distinct contexts, there is a natural tendency to pursue a one-size-fits-all solution to privacy. Unfortunately, this overlooks a crucial insight from decades of privacy research: privacy is inherently contextual. In this paper, we argue that existing work in prompt privacy is drifting towards attempts to design a unified framework, which is highly misleading and can foster a false sense of security. Furthermore, we argue that even future work in this direction needs to wrestle with fundamental tensions across various desirable properties of prompt privacy. Thus, such continued attempts towards a unified framework need to be reconsidered. We recommend three critical paths forward: application-specific deployment of LLMs, context-specific evaluation of privacy frameworks, and better privacy literacy.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

Language models relying on verbalized Chain-of-Thought (CoT) are constrained to token-by-token generation in the language space, where many tokens serve textual coherence rather than core reasoning. This entangles genuine differences in logical trajectories with superficial variations in verbalization. Moving reasoning into a compact, continuous latent space offers a promising alternative for efficiently representing and exploring diverse reasoning trajectories. However, current latent models remain largely deterministic, capturing only a single reasoning trajectory rather than modeling a distribution over multiple valid alternatives. Furthermore, their reliance on autoregressive latent prediction during training precludes effective parallelization, leading to prohibitively long training times. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Mixed-integer programming solvers expose hundreds or even thousands of parameters whose best setting varies per instance, yet per-instance search is prohibitively expensive.

Mixed-integer programming solvers expose hundreds or even thousands of parameters whose best setting varies per instance, yet per-instance search is prohibitively expensive. We frame this as configuration for heterogeneous Big Data optimization workloads and propose a nominate-then-adjudicate pipeline built around two design choices. First, a fixed portfolio is sampled once and reused across instances, removing per-instance configuration search at inference; on the evaluated families, the resulting shortlist retains substantial oracle headroom, making selection within it the empirical focus. Second, the fixed 20-feature representation can map structurally different instances to the same vector, preventing a feature-only selector from distinguishing them even when they prefer different configurations. The foundation model receives no task-specific weight updates, and selection is one-pass: one model call and no solver calls at inference. The study represents structural Variety through distinct formulation families and decision Value through solver-performance outcomes; the one-call, zero-solve protocol specifies the decision interface and leaves end-to-end latency unmeasured. item.title: MA-UITD: Offline Multi-Agent Reward Inference for Characterizing Continuous Social Behavior
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Multi-agent inverse reinforcement learning offers a powerful framework not only for imitation learning but also for understanding the neural computations supporting social interactions and decision-making.

Multi-agent inverse reinforcement learning offers a powerful framework not only for imitation learning but also for understanding the neural computations supporting social interactions and decision-making. Inferring rewards from interacting agents is challenging because observed choices reflect both personal preferences and expectations about others. Existing methods often require additional environment interaction, repeated policy optimization as an inner loop, or restrictive assumptions about environment dynamics and action spaces, limiting their applicability to fixed behavioral datasets. We introduce Multi-Agent Unilateral Inverse Temporal Difference Learning (MA-UITD), an offline method for inferring explicit agent-specific rewards from joint demonstrations in continuous-state environments with either discrete or bounded continuous actions. Its core idea is to represent the long-term consequences of each agent's own actions through belief-conditioned successor features that average over other agents' behavior. Multi-agent inverse reinforcement learning offers a powerful framework not only for imitation learning but also for understanding the neural computations supporting social interactions and decision-making. item.title: Loopholing All the Way: Language Modeling with pure Self-Conditioning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Recent Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) use Self-Conditioning (SC), or Loopholing, to improve their performance.

Recent Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) use Self-Conditioning (SC), or Loopholing, to improve their performance. While SC is traditionally seen as an auxiliary heuristic, its empirical success raises the question: can a continuous generative model be based purely on Self-Conditioning? We answer affirmatively with LAW (``Loopholing All the Way''), which propagates the Expected Embedding under the denoiser's prediction across steps, decoding the tokens once, at the end. On Sudoku, LAW outperforms previous Discrete and Continuous Diffusion Models, including Loopholing Discrete Diffusion. On Maze, LAW is the most accurate from 2 to 64 NFE. After training on TinyGSM and sampling at temperature 1 with 1024 NFE, LAW solves 42.2% of GSM8K problems against 34.5% for uniform Loopholing Discrete Diffusion. Additionally, fine-tuning a pre-trained Uniform Diffusion Model (Duo) with LAW increases its accuracy from 17.2% to 48.1%. Finally, on OpenWebText, LAW pushes the Pareto frontier and approaches Autoregressive Models (ARMs) with 64 NFE. Find our code at https://github.com/ilievanadezhda/law.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

We present a local and sparse kernel method for learning the solution operators of incompressible flows.

We present a local and sparse kernel method for learning the solution operators of incompressible flows. It builds on our earlier property-preserving kernel method, whose global output reconstruction and dense operator regression scale poorly. Our method replaces the global output reconstruction by local divergence-free interpolants with divergence-free polynomials of any degree, solved in parallel on the GPU. These interpolants are divergence free, periodic on periodic domains, and, with a multiscale kernel, approach Kolmogorov statistics under refinement. A compactly supported kernel, positive semidefinite in any input dimension, makes the operator regression sparse. Its support radius, and hence the sparsity, is fitted to data, and optional affine polynomials in the input capture global trends. Operator Lagrange weights join the two. They cost one sparse solve per new input and act on the training fields before the output reconstruction, so their local coefficients are never formed. We show that, unlike direct evaluation, Lagrange evaluation does not amplify solve errors by the cancellation among spatial coefficients. item.title: How Not to Be Censored: Inclusion Safety in Client-Led Consensus
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Blockchain consensus protocols implicitly follow a client-server architecture: validators are the only active participants, while clients (i.e., users) merely submit transactions and rely on validators to include them.

Blockchain consensus protocols implicitly follow a client-server architecture: validators are the only active participants, while clients (i.e., users) merely submit transactions and rely on validators to include them. This abstraction obscures a fundamental question: what should a client do to guarantee the timely inclusion of its own transaction? We study this question by introducing a leaderless consensus protocol in which clients are active. We define inclusion safety: the guarantee that a client's transaction enters some of the blocks produced for an epoch, and that every block omitting it belongs to a fork that is eventually abandoned. Because every transaction carries a reference to a block of the previous epoch, clients help select the surviving fork. This yields two paths to inclusion: reaching sufficiently many honest replicas within an epoch, or relaying a block containing the transaction across epochs until the corresponding fork becomes canonical. item.title: How Far Can Foundation Models Be Distilled for Efficient Jet Tagging?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Jet tagging is one of the most important applications of machine learning at the Large Hadron Collider.

Jet tagging is one of the most important applications of machine learning at the Large Hadron Collider. Recent models build in more physics knowledge or rely on large-scale pretraining, but the experiments place strict limits on their inference cost. Knowledge distillation can transfer their performance to small students that are cheap to run. We ask which properties of a teacher help the student, how small a student can get and how close it can come to the state of the art. On a jet tagging benchmark, we distil six teachers that differ in architecture, symmetry and pretraining, including two foundation models, into five small students. Every teacher improves every student, and the gain depends mainly on the strength of the teacher. We then shrink our two strongest distilled students, Transformer and L-GATr-slim, in width and in depth. With 20 thousand parameters, a distilled L-GATr-slim outperforms every published jet tagger trained from scratch at a fraction of the inference cost of every teacher. Even with two thousand parameters, it matches ParT, a model with a thousand times as many parameters. We also study what the students learn from their teachers. Our benchmark of inferen…

item.title: Hard and Soft Real-Time DNN Inference Scheduling on Heterogeneous Multi-Accelerator Systems via Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 异构多加速器系统上同时承载硬实时（HRT）与软实时 QoS 感知的 DNN 推理，如何保证硬截止期又提升软实时服务质量？

方法 在线 RL 调度器 + 确定性运行时安全层：RL 联合选择子作业优先级与加速器分配生成候选调度；运行时认证独立于学习策略保证所有 HRT 截止期满足。提出基于机器级切割的可调度性保持前缀替换准则，无需完整完工时间支配即可保证可行续接。

关键数字 异构 DNN 加速器平台实验表明：在保持 HRT 可调度性的同时，相比最先进调度方法改善 QoS 截止期满足率、客户端级服务质量与加速器利用率。

为什么值得看 RL 调度与形式化安全保证结合，为"学习策略可用但不可信"的实时系统提供范式。

item.title: HAWK: Heterogeneity-Aware KV Cache Transfer for Efficient GPU-NPU Phase-Disaggregated LLM Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 GPU 适合 prefill、NPU 更适合 decode，异构 GPU-NPU 分离式推理需要把 KV cache 从 GPU 传到 NPU，但设备间通信机制与张量布局不同，传输困难。

方法 HAWK 传输机制：建立 RDMA 直传路径处理跨设备传输，在 NPU 侧分配张量布局感知的 RDMA 缓冲区以匹配目标张量布局，把数据从 GPU 常规连续 RDMA 缓冲区编排传输到对应 NPU 缓冲区，传输后可直接消费、无需额外重排。

关键数字 商用 GPU+NPU 系统上，同 SLO 约束下性能达 GPU-only 系统的 7.88% 以内，功耗效率最高 1.26x、成本效率最高 1.72x。

为什么值得看 GPU-NPU 混合部署是推理降本趋势，跨异构设备的 KV 传输优化对落地有直接价值。

item.title: Geometric knowledge spaces, Attention pairing and Architectures
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

In this paper, we propose a geometric approach to deriving attention mechanisms and exploring potential new transformer architectures.

In this paper, we propose a geometric approach to deriving attention mechanisms and exploring potential new transformer architectures. We begin by formalizing the notions of knowledge worlds and attention pairings, then demonstrate how this framework naturally leads to the architectures of standard attention, causal attention, linear attention, tensor attention, and recurrent neural networks. Finally, we introduce several new geometric spaces that may inspire novel neural network architectures.

item.title: Generative Modeling via Nonlinear Schrödinger Bridges and Branching Diffusions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

We propose a new generative modeling framework grounded in forward-backward partial differential equations (PDEs).

We propose a new generative modeling framework grounded in forward-backward partial differential equations (PDEs). These equations arise naturally in mean-field game (MFG) theory, and are closely related to nonlinear Schrödinger systems. Our main contribution is to reinterpret this connection within the setting of generative modeling and to develop an efficient numerical methodology for its practical implementation. Specifically, we derive and characterize a nonlinear extension of the classical Schrödinger bridge problem through a coupled system of PDEs, yielding a model we call SBNL (Schrödinger Bridge NonLinear). To compute its solution, we design a simulation algorithm based on branching diffusions and the probabilistic representation of semilinear PDEs. The resulting method is embarrassingly parallel, scalable to high dimensions, and applicable to a broad class of nonlinear interaction functionals. Understanding generalization of randomized learning algorithms remains a central challenge.

Understanding generalization of randomized learning algorithms remains a central challenge. Mutual-information and total-variation bounds provide complementary ways to quantify data--hypothesis dependence, but they can behave quite differently in high-dimensional regimes. Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) models improve scalability by routing input tokens to only a subset of expert networks, but they often suffer from representation collapse, in which multiple experts converge toward similar functions and lose their intended diversity. Prior work has addressed this limitation either by improving router architectures or by introducing auxiliary loss terms that implicitly penalize similarity among experts. However, router-based approaches remain vulnerable to routing collapses, and loss-based approaches can conflict with the task's original objective during optimization. item.title: FrontierCS 2: A Benchmark for Computer Science R&D
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Can LLM agents make contributions to frontier computer science R&D?

Can LLM agents make contributions to frontier computer science R&D? We introduce FrontierCS 2, a benchmark of 48 open-ended tasks. We take a paper and the code its authors released and delete the paper's contribution. The deleted code becomes the human reference that sets the bar. Earlier open-ended benchmarks give each agent a problem statement and grade one program after the run. FrontierCS 2 places the agent inside a research environment. The agent inherits a working repository and may submit a patch at any point. For each patch, a judge returns a development-suite score but keeps the evaluator, the held-out final suite and the reference private, and grades the final submission on that suite against the reference. The tasks span 13 domains, from machine-learning systems and high-performance computing to databases, security and robotics. Beyond these 48 tasks, FrontierCS 2 keeps a private set of more than 100 tasks, to be announced in the future. We evaluate 12 agents. The best one is Claude Opus 5.5, passing 58% of its runs. No run passes on 16 tasks. A higher score is not the same as a pass: most runs that beat the reference on the combined final score still fall short on some …

The agent inherits a working repository and may submit a patch at any point. For each patch, a judge returns a development-suite score but keeps the evaluator, the held-out final suite and the reference private, and grades the final submission on that suite against the reference. The tasks span 13 domains, from machine-learning systems and high-performance computing to databases, security and robotics. Beyond these 48 tasks, FrontierCS 2 keeps a private set of more than 100 tasks, to be announced in the future. We evaluate 12 agents. The best one is Claude Opus 5.5, passing 58% of its runs. No run passes on 16 tasks. A higher score is not the same as a pass: most runs that beat the reference on the combined final score still fall short on some …

item.title: Flat-RLVR: Sharpness-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Reasoning Capacity in LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), particularly through group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), has emerged as a central paradigm for the post-training of large language models (LLMs).

Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), particularly through group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), has emerged as a central paradigm for the post-training of large language models (LLMs). While RLVR is highly effective at enhancing the reasoning capabilities of LLMs, it commonly induces \textit{distribution sharpening}, whereby the policy distribution becomes excessively peaked and rare-yet-correct trajectories are progressively suppressed, thus diminishing sample diversity. To this end, we promote flat-reward optima in RLVR to smooth the policy distribution. We theoretically link flat reward RLVR to reduced distribution sharpening, and empirically show improved sample diversity while maintaining single-attempt accuracy. Our method, called \texttt{Flat}-RLVR, searches for flat reward regions via sharpness-aware minimization during LLM post-training, combining this with GRPO variants to achieve better trade-offs between sampling efficiency and reasoning capacity.

item.title: Extending FAIR Principles with Observability for Trustworthy Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Federated learning (FL) keeps data at its source, but locality alone does not make a federation trustworthy.

Federated learning (FL) keeps data at its source, but locality alone does not make a federation trustworthy. Without sufficient observability, an aggregator cannot determine whether the client service was healthy, the local data pipeline was trustworthy, or contractual constraints were properly monitored during training. We take the position that trustworthy FL needs an evidence plane in addition to its model-update process. Each participant continuously summarizes local infrastructure, data into minimal, signed trust evidence associated with each FL round, while raw data, logs remain local. A local TinyLLM may assist in interpreting observability signals, deriving contextual evidence, and providing natural-language explanations to operators. We instantiate this vision through FAIR-O, an observability extension of FAIR principle. Rather than benchmarking FL accuracy, a three-level trust model has been proposed and a two-participant Python prototype demonstrates evidence generation and trust assessment. We further discuss future integration of FAIR-O Trust Evidence into participant selection, evidence weighting, and federated aggregation.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Estimating Performance for Safe Deployment of Machine Learning Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

The main challenge in applying deep neural networks to real-world scenarios lies in distributional discrepancies between training and test datasets, often caused by variations in data acquisition conditions.

The main challenge in applying deep neural networks to real-world scenarios lies in distributional discrepancies between training and test datasets, often caused by variations in data acquisition conditions. Assessing the performance of pre-trained models without labels is crucial for safety, but this is complicated by deep models' overly optimistic probabilistic outputs, often exacerbated by class imbalances, leading to unreliable predictions. To address these issues, we introduce MOVAL, a novel MOdel eVALuation tool that estimates performance using unlabeled test data. MOVAL incorporates class-wise confidence calibration to adjust model outputs, allowing for the estimation of metrics beyond accuracy and mitigating the detrimental effects of class imbalance on confidence calibration. Additionally, we propose an ensemble approach that combines multiple calibrated confidence scores for a more robust solution. We validate MOVAL on natural and medical image datasets with various acquisition shifts, covering tasks from classification to segmentation. It achieves state-of-the-art results across evaluation metrics such as accuracy, F1-Score, AUC, and more. Furthermore, we demonstrate tha…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Subgraph enumeration in partitioned graphs across distributed-memory systems is beset with challenges in balancing data movement with the local computation.

Subgraph enumeration in partitioned graphs across distributed-memory systems is beset with challenges in balancing data movement with the local computation. Especially, counting the number of triangles induced by the closed wedges (i.e., length-3 cycles) is a measure of connectedness in a graph, but often limited by the significant search space caused by open wedges or length-2 paths (usually greater than the number of edges in a graph), which must be inspected to assess whether a particular wedge is closed. To mitigate triangle counting on massive graphs, distributed-memory partitioned-graph approaches are viable (i.e., assessing closed wedges independently within a partition), but load imbalance due to arbitrary communication can overshadow any gains from enhanced concurrency, owing to the inherent lack of structure in regular graphs. In this paper, we discuss a distributed-memory exact graph triangle counting implementation, and assess its performance over billion-edge real-world graphs on contemporary scale-out and scale-up based NVIDIA GPU platforms (considering NVIDIA ``Ampere'' and ``Hopper'' architectures), depicting a scalability spectrum of multiple orders of magnitude. Reinforcement learning (RL) based on PPO-style clipping has become an effective approach to improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, standard token-level clipping measures policy change only through the conditional probability of the current token, while the prefix conditioning context is itself generated by the policy. This mismatch becomes especially consequential in long-response and off-policy training. We reformulate autoregressive generation as a finite-horizon Markov decision process and derive its performance-difference identity under behavior-policy sampling. The resulting change of measure identifies the cumulative likelihood ratio of the generated prefix as the exact importance weight for each stepwise policy-improvement term. Starting from the monotonic-improvement principle of trust-region policy optimization, we then construct a prefix-level trust region using the exact reverse-KL coordinate $r-1-\log r$, whose behavior-policy expectation equals the corresponding prefix-distribution KL divergence. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Time series anomalies take diverse forms, and individual detectors encode different anomaly scoring principles that rarely cover all anomaly types.

Time series anomalies take diverse forms, and individual detectors encode different anomaly scoring principles that rarely cover all anomaly types. Recent unsupervised time-series anomaly detectors provide complementary scoring signals, yet deploying them as an ensemble preserves the inference and maintenance cost of every individual detector. We study whether heterogeneous teacher detectors can be distilled into a single lightweight detector in the unsupervised setting, where no anomaly labels are available to define a shared target. AnoMix addresses this by extracting weak pairwise supervision from the training-set anomaly scores of frozen teachers. It normalizes each teacher score sequence independently and trains the student with CoRank, a multi-teacher ranking-distillation objective that converts teacher score gaps into pairwise supervision through teacher consensus. Across seven benchmark datasets, AnoMix successfully integrates complementary teacher scoring principles into a single deployable model, improving over individual detectors and static score ensembles while using a compact student with under 80k parameters on the benchmark settings. Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF) has become a central paradigm for aligning Large Language Models with human values. However, the reliance on sensitive preference data necessitates rigorous differential privacy (DP) guarantees to prevent user information leakage. Existing private alignment methods typically assume dense reward parameterizations, resulting in estimation error bounds that scale polynomially with the ambient {model size $d$}. Such dependence is prohibitive in modern {overparameterized models} where $d$ is vast. In this work, we study \emph{Private Sparse RLHF} problem to address this limitation, assuming that human preferences (reward model) are governed by a subset of $s^* \ll d$ relevant features. item.title: Delay-Guided Attention for Quality Prediction in Multistage Manufacturing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Quality prediction in multistage manufacturing is challenging when inter-stage lags vary over time, as measurements taken at the same timestamp may reflect different process states.

Quality prediction in multistage manufacturing is challenging when inter-stage lags vary over time, as measurements taken at the same timestamp may reflect different process states. Existing approaches often preserve production order but fuse timestamp-aligned features or model delayed dependencies implicitly, without identifying the upstream history relevant to each downstream observation. We propose Delay-Guided Attention for Multi-stage Forecasting (DAMF), which explicitly estimates inter-stage lag distributions and uses them to guide cross-stage information transfer for final quality prediction. For each adjacent stage pair, a lag predictor compares the current downstream representation with candidate lagged upstream representations. An occurrence-magnitude factorization separately estimates the probability of a positive lag and its conditional magnitude, yielding a sample- and stage-pair-specific distribution over discrete lag states without requiring plant-specified delays at inference. DelayAlignment incorporates this soft distribution as a temporal prior into differentiable cross-stage attention, while gated residual fusion regulates information propagation across productio…

item.title: Day-0 Support for Flint on vLLM
item.description:
发表方：vLLM Blog　发布：2026-10-21　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 新 MoE 模型 Recursive Flint（40B 参数、每 token 激活约 2.5B、262K 上下文、滑动窗口注意力）如何在 vLLM 上拿到 Day-0 支持并做到高效解码。

要点 vLLM 从发布第一天支持 Flint：NVFP4 与 BF16 两个 checkpoint 均可单 GPU 运行；架构上 35 层滑动窗口（513 token）+14 层全上下文（仅这 14 层保留全序列 KV，缓存 28 KiB/token）、256 专家 sigmoid top-6+共享专家；NVFP4 为 GGUF 封装、加载时无损重打包，以 W4A16 权重仅权重模式运行，各 kernel 对齐参考实现舍入点；逐项替换小批量 kernel（融合 Q/K norm+RoPE+KV 写、小批量 MoE GEMV、低时延解码路径等）。

关键数字 单请求 GB200 上约 500 token/s（100K 上下文）；NVFP4 decode 4.81→1.78 ms（2.7×）、BF16 3.53→2.34 ms（1.5×）、8K prefill 207→145 ms（1.4×），前向 kernel 数 1096→346；端到端 batch-1 100K 上下文 2.06 ms/token（约 485 token/s）。

为什么值得看 展示新 MoE 模型从"能跑"到"跑得快"的完整 kernel 优化路径，对长上下文+滑动窗口架构的推理调优有直接借鉴。

item.title: Cross-Area Transfer Learning for VLC-based Indoor Localization with a Transfer Efficiency Score
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Indoor localization systems are critical for Industry-4.0 applications.

Indoor localization systems are critical for Industry-4.0 applications. Visible Light Communication (VLC)-based systems offer advantages such as immunity to electromagnetic interference, high accuracy, and energy efficiency, but their performance is hindered by environmental variability across deployment areas. This paper presents a transfer learning (TL) framework for VLC-based indoor localization that enhances cross-area robustness while reducing data requirements. Using real-world measurements from four distinct areas of a Bosch manufacturing facility, we show that fine-tuning a deep neural network (DNN) pre-trained on source area data with only 40% of target-area measurements recovers 97% of full-data performance, thereby reducing the amount of target data needed. We further introduce the Transfer Efficiency Score (TES), a composite metric that identifies the most effective source models for transfer without exhaustive evaluation. Guided by TES, the framework selects the best source model, yielding localization errors as low as 40.9 cm with success rates above 86%. Validation on an unseen area confirms its generalization capability, with a 3.28 cm mean error achieved using the …

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

X-ray and neutron scattering are indispensable for structural characterization across condensed-matter physics and materials science.

X-ray and neutron scattering are indispensable for structural characterization across condensed-matter physics and materials science. Yet, because scattering experiments generally record intensities without phase information, distinct structures can yield similar scattering patterns, rendering the corresponding inverse problems non-unique. This ambiguity can be reduced by combining complementary measurements, but their integration into machine-learning frameworks remains challenging. Here we introduce a modular framework for probabilistic multi-measurement analysis based on prior-amortized flow matching. Single-observation posterior estimators are trained separately for individual observation types or physical probes and combined only at inference time through a compositional sampler. This late fusion approach allows pretrained single-observation models to be reused without dedicated joint retraining. As a case in point, we consider reflectometry, which provides depth-resolved, nanometer-scale information about thin films and interfaces. item.title: Circuits of LLM Classifiers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Language models make it easy to build classifiers by simply prompting a model with the sample to classify.

Language models make it easy to build classifiers by simply prompting a model with the sample to classify. However, their predictions are neither deterministic nor uniformly reliable across samples. How can we combine predictions from different models to improve reliability? We view LLM classifiers as noisy measurement instruments of an underlying target label. Our goal is to maximize average classification accuracy at a given average query cost. To this end, we introduce circuits that organize LLM classifiers into an adaptive sequence of queries and decisions. We then characterize the optimal circuit, obtain the fundamental limits of achievable accuracy, and provide practical insights on realizing the optimal circuit. Across seven classification tasks spanning safety, health, political science, human preference, agent evaluation, decision-making and reasoning, our method improves the cost-accuracy frontier over routing and cascading baselines.

item.title: CORD: Conflict-Aware Optimization for Joint RL and Distillation in Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Joint reinforcement learning and self-distillation combines task rewards with dense teacher guidance for agent training, but their gradients can partly cancel.

Joint reinforcement learning and self-distillation combines task rewards with dense teacher guidance for agent training, but their gradients can partly cancel. A mixing coefficient controls relative scale without selectively removing opposing components. We present CORD, a general framework for conflict-aware optimization of two objectives. CORD separates the choice of protected objective from the condition that triggers projection, and combines the gradients once per optimizer mini-batch. A nearest-point formulation yields a closed-form update and characterizes its first-order effect on the protected objective before optimizer transformations. Gradient diagnostics connect conflict in agent training to lost local optimization progress and motivate selective correction. As a gradient-combination mechanism, CORD can be added to different joint training recipes while retaining their objectives. Across three such recipes, it improves ALFWorld success by 1.5-15.9 percentage points. On WebShop, it improves two of the three pairs, with SDAR rising from 60.7% to 64.6% success. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Recent electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models increasingly emphasize model scale, potentially limiting their deployment on resource-constrained devices and in everyday environments.

Recent electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models increasingly emphasize model scale, potentially limiting their deployment on resource-constrained devices and in everyday environments. We argue that transferable EEG features can instead be learned with a compact architecture and introduce BrainCodes, a lightweight foundation model pretrained through self-supervised learning on more than 800 hours of recordings from over 1,000 participants. Our architecture combines a quantization-based neural tokenizer with a spatiotemporal encoder that supports arbitrary electrode configurations. The pretraining objective explicitly encourages representations that capture spatial connectivity through channel positional encoding, and sensitivity to narrowband neural oscillations through an auxiliary training objective. Our model matches or surpasses the state of the art across diverse neurophysiological monitoring tasks, including sleep staging, attention assessment, and cognitive load estimation. BrainCodes transfers effectively to low-resource wearable devices while using up to 97% fewer trainable parameters than comparable architectures. item.description:

Autoregressive (AR) models have proved effective for zero-shot prediction from longitudinal electronic health records, but impose strictly sequential generation on trajectories containing temporally clustered and interdependent clinical events.

Autoregressive (AR) models have proved effective for zero-shot prediction from longitudinal electronic health records, but impose strictly sequential generation on trajectories containing temporally clustered and interdependent clinical events. We investigate block-based masked diffusion (BD) as an alternative on MIMIC-IV under matched tokenisation, context length, model capacity, and evaluation conditions. Across block sizes, BD exhibits a clear quality--efficiency trade-off, with small-block configurations retaining much of the predictive performance of AR while enabling substantially faster inference. A representative $B{=}8$ configuration achieves approximately $1.43\times$ faster evaluation. Although generative rollout remains below AR in most settings, frozen linear probes on BD and AR representations achieve near-identical performance across clinical prediction tasks, indicating that BD learns comparably informative clinical representations. Increasing the denoising budget yields diminishing returns, while alternative decoding strategies provide limited gains. Overall, our results show that block diffusion is a viable and computationally attractive approach to longitudinal E…

item.title: Benchmarking and Error Analysis of Deep Search and Deep Research LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous Deep Search and Deep Research Agents capable of executing long-horizon, multi-step tasks, evaluating their reliability becomes increasingly critical.

As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous Deep Search and Deep Research Agents capable of executing long-horizon, multi-step tasks, evaluating their reliability becomes increasingly critical. However, existing evaluation paradigms predominantly focus on final task outcomes, leaving a significant gap in understanding the intermediate execution traces, where agents are highly susceptible to various errors. To address this critical gap, we introduce a comprehensive methodology and analytical framework designed specifically to diagnose errors in intermediate workflows. Building upon this framework, we establish a structured taxonomy that categorizes these vulnerabilities into two primary dimensions: System-Level Errors and Task-Level Errors. Through a systematic examination of step-by-step execution traces and agent-environment interactions, we reveal how these underlying errors affect overall performance. Finally, through empirical experiments and systematic analysis of the identified error types, we provide actionable design guidelines, aiming to enhance the robustness, reasoning capabilities, and reliability of Deep Search and Deep Research agents.

item.title: BatchBench: Benchmarking AI Robustness to Batch Effects and Domain Shift in Biomedical Images - A JUMP Cell Painting Leaderboard
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-21　分类：论文PDF

Despite recent advances, current AI systems remain highly susceptible to domain shifts, particularly in biomedical imaging, where images are usually acquired under substantially different experimental conditions.

Despite recent advances, current AI systems remain highly susceptible to domain shifts, particularly in biomedical imaging, where images are usually acquired under substantially different experimental conditions. Although recent domain adaptation methods have made substantial progress, significant performance gaps under domain shift persist. To measure progress in this regard, we introduce BatchBench, a leaderboard that evaluates and compares the robustness of AI systems on biomedical images from unseen experimental batches and data sources. BatchBench is built on JUMP-CP, one of the largest publicly available biomedical imaging datasets. Generated using the Cell Painting assay, JUMP-CP exhibits pronounced batch effects and domain shifts, making it a challenging testbed for evaluating robustness to distributional changes.

item.title: Announcing Humming: Fast, Flexible Kernels for Quantized Inference
item.description:
发表方：vLLM Blog　发布：2026-10-21　分类：技术博客 / 每日精选

核心话题 量化推理 kernel 开发维护成本随模型与 GPU 代际组合爆炸——每新增量化格式/后端都要专属 kernel、预处理、适配与测试，vLLM 生态需要一种通用、高性能的量化 kernel 库。

要点 Ant Group 与 vLLM 社区开源 Humming：把量化描述与执行选择分离、kernel 由共享组件组合而成；统一量化表示转换各工具导出格式，支持 Turing 以来 NVIDIA GPU 与 CUDA 兼容设备（如 T-Head Zhenwu 810E），覆盖稠密与 MoE 的各类权重/激活格式组合（WNA16/W8A8/W4A8/W4A4 与 INT4/NVFP4 等）。

关键数字 支持 NVIDIA Turing 起全系 GPU；覆盖多种整数/浮点类型、位宽与缩放方案组合；在多个代表性负载上显著优于 vLLM Marlin、FlashInfer、DeepGEMM 现有实现。

为什么值得看 把"为每种组合写 kernel"的维护负担降为"描述+组件组合"，是量化推理基础设施的一次范式简化，仓库已开源。

The rapid expansion of the Internet of Things enables seamless collaboration among connected devices, making indoor localization a critical component of industrial automation.

The rapid expansion of the Internet of Things enables seamless collaboration among connected devices, making indoor localization a critical component of industrial automation. However, conventional localization techniques struggle in dynamic environments. These methods depend on extensive, frequent data collection and environment-specific calibration, limiting scalability, interoperability, and effective use of prior research while imposing significant energy penalties that hinder practical deployment. To address these challenges, we propose an energy-efficient transfer learning (TL) based approach for visible light communication based indoor localization. Our method leverages TL to tackle environmental variability, including lighting fluctuations and physical obstacles that typically degrade localization performance, while simultaneously reducing computational overhead and energy consumption compared to conventional approaches. This paper presents Making Tax Smart with Open Banking (MTS-OB), a novel DLT-based architecture designed to integrate real-time VAT compliance into the existing payment system through split payments and Open Banking.

This paper presents Making Tax Smart with Open Banking (MTS-OB), a novel DLT-based architecture designed to integrate real-time VAT compliance into the existing payment system through split payments and Open Banking. Motivated by the substantial VAT gap, the research investigates how leveraging the informational value embedded within payment transactions can reduce the tax administration burden. MTS-OB, a proof-of-concept application built on R3 Corda, facilitates automated, real-time VAT split payments (VSP) without disrupting current payment infrastructure. MTS-OB integrates with existing banking systems via Open Banking APIs, enabling secure information management for VAT collection, reporting, analytics, and automated compliance enforcement. The system uses traditional bank deposit money as a real-time information sensor thereby extending its functionality to include "money as a medium of real-time taxation". Scalability testing demonstrates the system's ability to maintain operational stability under increasing transaction loads, illustrating its potential for real-world deployment. item.title: ZKPU: Zero-Knowledge Processing Unit for Heterogeneous Workloads
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) have become a fundamental building block for privacy-preserving computation, blockchain systems, and verifiable machine learning.

Zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) have become a fundamental building block for privacy-preserving computation, blockchain systems, and verifiable machine learning. Modern ZKP protocols span two distinct families: curve-based protocols, which rely on large finite-field arithmetic, and hash-based protocols, which operate over native 64-bit fields. Existing hardware accelerators are specialized for one protocol family because they are built on operand-scanning Montgomery multiplication, resulting in fixed-width datapaths, poor utilization across heterogeneous operand widths, and limited scalability. This paper presents \emph{ZKPU}, a Zero-Knowledge Processing Unit for heterogeneous ZKP workloads. ZKPU introduces a new compute paradigm by co-designing finely integrated product scanning (FIPS) Montgomery multiplication with a reconfigurable Twin Systolic Fabric (TSF), enabling modular multiplication at arbitrary widths in 64-bit increments. Combined with a fine-grained Deque buffer, on-chip twiddle-factor generator, and memory-efficient MSM preprocessing strategy, ZKPU provides a unified architecture for both curve-based and hash-based protocols. Evaluation using Groth16 and Plonky2 shows th…

Large language models (LLMs) can leverage semantic feature names alongside summary statistics for tabular feature selection, yet it remains unclear when such information improves subset selection relative to established statistical methods.

Large language models (LLMs) can leverage semantic feature names alongside summary statistics for tabular feature selection, yet it remains unclear when such information improves subset selection relative to established statistical methods. We investigate this question within an 18-dataset framework comprising 10 datasets for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) training, 2 for checkpoint validation, and 6 held-out evaluation datasets. We compare five classical baselines, frozen Qwen2.5-7B and Llama-3.3-70B selectors, and two GRPO-adapted Qwen2.5-7B models, reporting classification ROC-AUC and regression R^2 separately and using dataset-wise ranks for cross-task comparison. Across five seeded evaluation partitions, classical selectors generally achieve higher predictive performance than the tested 7B LLM/RL selectors, including under a pre-specified ~33% feature budget with strict train-only classical fitting, while the 7B selectors retain compact subsets. Large language models (LLMs) can leverage semantic feature names alongside summary statistics for tabular feature selection, yet it remains unclear when such information improves subset selection relative to established statistical methods. We investigate this question within an 18-dataset framework comprising 10 datasets for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) training, 2 for checkpoint validation, and 6 held-out evaluation datasets. We compare five classical baselines, frozen Qwen2.5-7B and Llama-3.3-70B selectors, and two GRPO-adapted Qwen2.5-7B models, reporting classification ROC-AUC and regression R^2 separately and using dataset-wise ranks for cross-task comparison. Across five seeded evaluation partitions, classical selectors generally achieve higher predictive performance than the tested 7B LLM/RL selectors, including under a pre-specified ~33% feature budget with strict train-only classical fitting, while the 7B selectors retain compact subsets. A cardinality-matched semantic sensitivity experiment shows that, for Zero-shot Qwen-7B, informative feature names improve regression performance over anonymized and shuffled alternatives (+0.1964 and +0.1606 mean R^2), wher…

item.title: When Do Gaussian Priors Fail? A Latent Geometry Investigation of RL Fine-Tuning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Latent diffusion models almost universally place a Gaussian prior on the VAE latent space.

Latent diffusion models almost universally place a Gaussian prior on the VAE latent space. For base generation this default is unproblematic; under reinforcement-learning fine-tuning, however, it carries a structural limitation. The standard VAE's KL term does not merely ignore mode structure - it actively taxes separation and tightness. When data are multimodal, the ELBO optimum compresses distinct modes into an overlapping latent. RL fine-tuning amplifies this overlap: the score network is under-resolved on the saddle region between modes, dynamic-to-variational amplification rises sharply, and the collapse boundary beta_c is pushed far above its variational scale. On the real alanine-dipeptide Boltzmann distribution, a Gaussian-prior VAE collapses at beta_c = 0.224 while a mode-tracked Gaussian-mixture prior collapses at 0.00316, a 71x gap from the same pipeline. We trace this gap to a single geometric mediator, d_min/(2 sigma_0), and verify the causal chain through controlled interventions: moving geometry at fixed prior, and switching prior at matched geometry (full mediation; prior-label coefficient 0.995x, 95% CI [0.79, 1.25]). item.title: Weight Placement Is Not Enough: Synchronization in Multi-Node CPU Decoding of Ternary LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 三值 LLM 每解码 token 只读几 GB，但四 NUMA 节点双路服务器上最快三值运行时只用不到一半内存带宽——把权重放在读取它的线程所在节点就够了吗？

方法 构建节点局部权重、复用 ik_llama kernel 的解码引擎，用逐线程 barrier 追踪定位等待来源；比较 Megatron 风格列切分与行切分（无跨节点归约），并隔离 barrier 数量效应。

关键数字 两代 Xeon 上线程每 token 有 20–48% 时间等在同步点，主要是等各节点最慢线程；列切分在全部配置下胜出；DRAM 受限解码较 ik_llama 全核快 1.5–2.1×、较其最快线程数 1.5–1.9×（L3 缓存小模型 3.2×/2.8×），同精度且每 token 能耗更低。

为什么值得看 指出多节点 CPU 三值解码的真正瓶颈在同步而非带宽，给出可复现的列切分工程答案。

item.title: Unsupervised Head Network Personalization for Split Computing via Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Split Computing (SC) is a distributed inference method designed for balancing computational load and reducing latency by partitioning a neural network into head and tail networks and deploying them across both a mobile device and a server, respectively.

Split Computing (SC) is a distributed inference method designed for balancing computational load and reducing latency by partitioning a neural network into head and tail networks and deploying them across both a mobile device and a server, respectively. Due to the limited bandwidth and computational power of mobile devices, the head network is often replaced with a neural network that requires lower computational and communication resources. However, it is challenging to prepare a sufficient quantity and quality of labeled data on the mobile device side for training the replacement head network. Furthermore, the data prepared by mobile users often contains sensitive privacy information, making data aggregation difficult. In this paper, we propose a data-efficient head network training method for SC. This method utilizes federated learning and knowledge distillation to train the head network using a small amount of non-IID and unlabeled data from mobile devices, ensuring that the training datasets are not exposed. Moreover, by introducing personalization, we enhance the accuracy to levels comparable to or exceeding those of existing methods. The experimental evaluations demonstrate …

item.title: Two Is Enough: Binary Classification Priors Suffice for Multi-Class In-Context Tabular Prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Tabular foundation models (TFMs) pretrain a transformer on large-scale synthetic priors so that a single forward pass yields zero-shot tabular prediction.

Tabular foundation models (TFMs) pretrain a transformer on large-scale synthetic priors so that a single forward pass yields zero-shot tabular prediction. TabICLv2 samples the class count of its classification prior during pretraining, and the prevailing configuration caps it at ten. We report a counter-intuitive result: setting this cap directly to two---making every pretrained classification task binary---still yields weights that perform zero-shot K-way classification 2. On the 38 TabArena classification datasets (200 bootstrap rounds, anchored at default RF = 1000), the binary two-stage recipe reaches 1590.1 Elo, above the official default at 1568.0 (+22.1), above TabPFN-v2.6 (1577.1) and RealTabPFN-v2.5 (1521.6). A production-scale validation on 60 real-world credit-scoring institutions independently confirms the direction: the same checkpoint improves test AUC on 44 of 60 institutions (paired Wilcoxon p = 0.0007 for AUC, p = 0.0002 for KS) at +1.5 inference cost. Mechanistically, classification in TabICLv2 is carried not by a fixed-cardinality output head but by an in-context comparison operator matching query-row embeddings against class-conditional embeddings, so the cardin…

item.title: Transformers as Generic Deep Neural Networks: Exact Compilation, the Cost of Removing Activation-Activation Products, and Multi-Agent Attention Clustering
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 Transformer 是否必须依赖专用 attention/归一化算子与特定量化算法？计算本身是否强制这种特殊化？

方法 证明每个 Transformer block（attention+LayerNorm+GELU MLP）可精确编译为通用 DNN（固定仿射映射、路由、square/sigmoid/inverse sqrt 加 GELU）；分析消除激活-激活乘积的代价；对 top-k attention 证明尾部质量估计的无偏/最小均方误差性质；查询聚类时由质心先选键。

关键数字 无激活-激活乘积时每个 head 的稠密分数至少增加 N² 次标量非线性求值，保留该运算即可免除；聚类使每 head 计算分数从 N² 降到 Nk；DeiT-Tiny/MambaIRv2-Light/Pythia-70M 编译后与参考完全匹配，DeiT-Tiny 上半数键的精确尾部质量估计即胜过 tail dropping。

为什么值得看 为没有专用 attention 算子的 NPU 提供精确编译路径，量化兼容性是额外加分。

item.title: Training-Free Continual Learning for Multimodal Forecasting via Prompt Evolution
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Adapting a forecasting system to a changing world classically means retraining.

Adapting a forecasting system to a changing world classically means retraining. We ask whether the task of continually learning regimes for time series forecasting can be represented by a piece of text: a guidance block, evolved by outcome-driven reflection and used in a frozen LLM forecaster's prompt. On a refreshed multimodal benchmark (weekly search indices, daily currencies, daily commodities, each window paired with web-retrieved news), we run GEPA-style prompt evolution under strict contamination control to prevent the data leakage common in timeseries benchmarks: the forecaster's knowledge cutoff predates every evaluated window. A 900-word evolved guidance carried by Llama-3.3-70B beats TimeSeries Foundation Models (TSFMs) on held-out data (GM MASE 0.776 vs. 0.898 for TabPFN-TS-3), transfers to more recent models without measurable loss, and costs dollars rather than GPU-days to update. We characterize the loop: out-of-loop gains concentrate in the first reflection, in-loop improvements overstate out-of-loop gains 2-3x unless an untouched monitor arbitrates, and error-only objectives silently suppress the text modality. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Task transition detection aims to identify when a person shifts from one task to another, providing a foundation for continuous health monitoring and timely context-aware interventions.

Task transition detection aims to identify when a person shifts from one task to another, providing a foundation for continuous health monitoring and timely context-aware interventions. While statistical and deep feature representations have demonstrated strong classification performance, they often rely on aggregated or latent features that are difficult to interpret in behavioural terms. Event-based features provide a compact and interpretable alternative by encoding behavioural and physiological patterns as discrete tokens with explicit semantic meaning, making them well suited for behavioural analysis in health informatics. Self-attention offers a mechanism for modelling interactions among such tokens; however, conventional self-attention classifiers primarily rely on token order and do not explicitly incorporate timing or duration information. As a result, informative temporal cues in event representations may not be fully exploited for task transition detection. This study proposes an event-based time-aware self-attention framework that represents behavioural signals as sequences of discrete events augmented with onset timestamps and durations. item.title: The Token-Energy Law of LLM Decode: Active Bytes and Realized Time Account for Joules per Token
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 高效部署 LLM 需要理解模型架构、硬件与服务设置如何共同塑造每生成 token 的能耗——能否给出一个紧凑、可解释的每 token 能耗模型？

方法 提出 Token-Energy Law：GPU 板级每输出 token 能耗由两个核心维度决定——活跃字节（单次解码迭代内共享的稠密权重 + 每请求读写的私有 KV 历史）与实现解码时间（解码时长/输出 token 数）；两者与时间合成仿射形式，系数按模型与硬件/运行时配置校准。

关键数字 三模型 BF16 解码、NVIDIA Hopper 与 Blackwell GPU（含 Hopper 双卡张量并行）实测；固定系数+观测解码时间下，留出条件均值能耗估计与实测最大偏差 3.73%。

为什么值得看 一个定律统一解释 batch 摊销共享权重、长上下文推高私有 KV 需求、吞吐决定时间成本，能耗建模可直接复用。

item.title: The Optimal Ranking Tradeoffs Between Two Ranking Scores in Two-Class Classification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

The accuracy, true negative rate (negative class recall), true positive rate (positive class recall), negative predictive value (negative class precision), positive predictive value (positive class pr

The accuracy, true negative rate (negative class recall), true positive rate (positive class recall), negative predictive value (negative class precision), positive predictive value (positive class precision), class-specific intersections over unions, class-specific F-scores, Cohen's kappa, and balanced accuracy are scores that one intuitively wants to maximize when developing machine learning methods. However, they lead to different rankings of such methods. So, how can we establish a ranking that is an optimal tradeoff between any pair of these scores? It turns out that all these scores are special cases of ranking scores: a continuum of scores parameterized by the relative importance values assigned to the true negative, false positive, false negative, and true positive outcomes. Since all these scores are known to induce meaningful rankings, we seek the optimal tradeoffs among them. We consider the tradeoff between two scores to be optimal when it minimizes the Fréchet variance regarding the Kendall distance (also known as the bubble-sort distance) between rankings. item.title: The Dynamics of Collapse and Recovery in Clustered Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-10-20　分类：论文PDF

Clustered federated learning (CFL) can suffer from cluster collapse.

Clustered federated learning (CFL) can suffer from cluster collapse. In particular, under unfavorable initialization, early client assignments concentrate heterogeneous groups on one cluster model, which is then trained toward a pooled compromise, while another model receives no updates. Since the current models determine client routing and routing determines subsequent model updates, we formulate clustered federated learning as control of an unknown dynamical system, with cluster models as the evolving state, client routing patterns as the control input, and routing interventions as state dependent controllers. In a two group linear model, we identify an initialization region in which greedy routing makes collapse self reinforcing. We then derive finite horizon error dynamics showing how routing interventions can reverse collapse by repeatedly training the starved model, primarily with updates from its compatible group. Motivated by this condition, each client uses blocked EXP3 to choose between greedy routing and interventions that redirect updates toward unused models. Experiments show that with simpler predictors and faster specialist formation, autonomous controller selection …
